verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs reference restricted API keys with read and write scopes mapped to the specific public endpoints that require them (heygen-docs-8). That is a first-party scoped, least-privilege credential model an agent can be given. The evidence is a single index-level line from llms.txt, so the issuance flow and how fine-grained the scopes are remain unshown. missing for 10: detailed docs on creating and revoking restricted keys, scope granularity beyond read/write, per-agent or expiring credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration
